entries.summary: Published to GitHub Pages. Front-end defects corrected and four records fixed against the refresh rules.

Site: clicking the Program column header threw a TypeError and left the table unsorted.

Site: the timeline window was pinned to Sep 2026 - Oct 2027 and now tracks the current month.
